queries.query: Gwagwalada Nigeria official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Abuja Geographic Information Systems
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Abuja Geographic Information Systems (AGIS), the FCT geospatial and computerized cadastral/land-registry custodian. Its current FCT Lands pages document a Gwagwalada Unit, map production, cadastral plans and survey-data services, but no public parcel layer or anonymous geometry API was exposed.
